pollNotes: Scheduled every 15 minutes by .github/workflows/zfc-watch.yml. GitHub's cron is best-effort and runs late under load — treat the cadence as 'about every 15 minutes', not a guarantee. Requests are made one at a time with requestDelayMs between them, with an honest User-Agent, and robots.txt is fetched and obeyed before any product page is touched. A handful of requests per quarter-hour against a large retailer is a rounding error on their traffic; if that ever stops being true, raise the cron interval rather than adding parallelism.
